content_blocks.text: The wind howled through the empty streets of the city, carrying with it the faint echo of a long-lost signal. Alex stood on the rooftop, his eyes scanning the horizon. He had been searching for this moment for years, ever since he received the mysterious message from an unknown sender. The message spoke of a hidden signal, buried deep within the city’s forgotten corners. As the night grew darker, the signal grew clearer, a faint pulse that could only be heard by those with a certain sensitivity. Alex knew what he had to do. He reached into his pocket and pulled out a small device, its screen glowing with the promise of discovery. The signal was there, waiting, and he was ready to receive it.
